clips.title: The story
paras: In Ambermill, Dalaran Pendants focus the Kirin Tor's magic. The Forsaken seek them to hinder the wizards' work and trace the source of their power.

Kirin Tor sorcerers, conjurers, and protectors weave powerful spells in Ambermill, threatening Forsaken control of southern Silverpine Forest. Each carries an attuned Dalaran Pendant. At the Sepulcher, Shadow Priest Allister sends Forsaken operatives to recover the pendants, slowing the mages' efforts and uncovering who guides their magical weave.
